First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 8:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: several distances and paces. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the FWBA Saturday Club Ride group ride

One of the oldest clubs in North Texas. FWBA posts a Saturday ride every week, and Sundays most weeks, with the start rotating across Tarrant and nearby counties. Multiple distances and paces on each ride. Check the home page ride calendar for this week's start.
